# Code Myth Technologies

> Remote-first IT studio based in Chennai, India, building full-stack web
> applications, AI-powered products, and custom software for startups,
> SaaS, FinTech, EdTech, HealthTech, and internal business systems.

Code Myth Technologies (CMT) provides full-stack engineering, AI
engineering (RAG, LLM integration, AI agents, automation), API & backend
development, business analysis / product counseling for early-stage
founders, and ongoing support after launch. The team works remotely with
clients worldwide, with a stated response time of 24 hours on new
enquiries.
